summary: Badly decomposed bodies of three people found at a remote wooded campsite near Gunnison; a hiker found one late Sunday and the sheriff's office found two more on arrival Monday. Two bodies were inside a small zipped-up tent and one outside; personal belongings, tarps, and a lean-to built from local logs over a firepit at the scene.
notes: Discovery date 2023-07-09 used (hiker's Sunday find before the 2023-07-12 CPR article; 2023-07-09 was a Sunday). Sheriff Adam Murdie said the mummified/advanced decomposition suggests the three had been there through winter, possibly since late fall 2022 — deaths predate discovery by an unrecoverable amount. Cause pending autopsy; sheriff said freezing and/or starvation appeared likely. Identities withheld pending next-of-kin notification.
